title: ManaWG
name: manawg
description: Free, open-source app for shared flats: expenses, cleaning rota, shopping list, calendar and chat. Runs the app with PostgreSQL, sign-in and image storage. Source: https://github.com/Abuarchiv/manawg
note: Needs an SMTP account for sign-in codes (or the Mailpit test profile). POSTGRES_PASSWORD: letters and digits only, from openssl rand -hex 24 or any password generator; it is fixed when the database is first created, so keep it. JWT_SECRET: 32 or more characters; the stack derives its API keys from it and needs no key generation. Both are stored in the stack's environment. Every other secret is derived. Behind HTTPS, set APP_URL to the public address and SITE_ADDRESS to the bare domain for a Let's Encrypt certificate; for a reverse proxy keep :80. Details: docs/self-hosting.md.

env.name: APP_URL
env.label: Address people open
env.description: Full URL without a trailing slash, e.g. https://wg.example.com. Only localhost may use plain http.

env.name: SITE_ADDRESS
env.label: What the gateway serves
env.description: :80 for plain HTTP (localhost or behind a reverse proxy) or the bare domain, e.g. wg.example.com, for HTTPS with Let's Encrypt.

env.name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
env.label: Database password (letters and digits, 16 or more)
env.description: Fixed when the database is first created. Example: openssl rand -hex 24

env.name: JWT_SECRET
env.label: Signing secret (32 or more characters)
env.description: The Auth and Storage API keys are signed with it when the stack starts. Changing it later signs everyone out and breaks calendar feed and unsubscribe links, unless you set MEMBER_SESSION_SECRET yourself.

env.name: SMTP_HOST
env.label: SMTP server
env.description: Required: sign-in codes go out by mail. mailpit with the Mailpit profile below catches all mail for a test.

env.name: SMTP_ADMIN_EMAIL
env.label: Sender address
env.description: An address your SMTP provider accepts, e.g. noreply@example.com.

env.name: LEGAL_URL
env.label: Site with your legal pages (optional)
env.description: Needs /impressum, /datenschutz and /agb. Set it before others use the instance.

env.name: COMPOSE_PROFILES
env.label: Local test mail
env.description: Mailpit catches every mail at port 8025 of the Docker host. Also set SMTP_HOST to mailpit and SMTP_PORT to 1025.
